templates.name: Template Nvoip MySQL 1267 Log Guard
templates.description: NN-4522: detects MySQL error 1267 or Illegal mix of collations in application logs without executing SQL or changing collations.

items.name: MySQL 1267 collation errors
items.description: Collects only lines matching error 1267. Configure the path macro per host and ensure the Zabbix agent can read the application log without changing existing file permissions.

triggers.expression: count(/Template Nvoip MySQL 1267 Log Guard/logrt[{$NVOIP.MYSQL1267.LOG_PATH},"(?i)(MySQL[^0-9]{0,24}1267|Illegal mix of collations)",,,skip],5m)>0
triggers.name: Application logged MySQL 1267 collation error
triggers.description: A production application logged an incompatible-collation comparison. Identify the service/context and query, stop retry amplification, inspect both operand collations, and validate the fix with PREPARE on the target schema. Never alter protected table collations as incident response.

macros.description: Absolute logrt filename regular expression. Override per host; do not broaden file permissions for the agent.
